headline: Germany ZEW Economic Sentiment Index Rises to 35.6 in November
summary: The ZEW Economic Sentiment Index for Germany rose from 28.1 to 35.6 in November, beating market forecasts and signaling an improving economic recovery outlook.
why: The ZEW indicator measures institutional investor and analyst sentiment, serving as a leading indicator for Germany, Europe's largest economy.
why_moved: German investor sentiment exceeded analyst expectations, raising confidence in Europe's largest economy.
